title: The Northern Ferry
teaser: The ferry has been sailing non-stop for three days because the port is closed by a storm. The port inspector was found in the car deck, though his cabin locked from the inside. Three people had keys, and the inspector's body bears traces of two different people.

habits.label: Gets seasick
clues: A full paper bag, the kind handed out for seasickness, stands by the ladder down to the car deck. The culprit gets seasick.
On the table in the inspector's cabin there's an empty blister of seasickness pills, and Bergström never took them. The culprit can't handle the rolling sea.

habits.label: Swallow tattoo
habits.habit: A swallow tattooed on the back of the hand
clues: At 02:40 someone on deck saw a hand with a tattooed swallow holding a torch by the car deck hatch. The culprit has a swallow on their hand.
The last line in the inspector's notebook reads: "Swallow on the hand. Same person as in Gdańsk." The culprit has a swallow tattoo.

habits.label: Sailor's knots
clues: The tarpaulin on the car next to the body is tied with a bowline, a knot used only at sea. The culprit can tie sailor's knots.
A cord is tied to the inside handle of the inspector's cabin door with a sheet bend, which pulls tight when the door is slammed from outside. The culprit can tie sailor's knots.

habits.label: Skinned knuckles
clues: There's a smear of blood at fist height on the wing of a lorry in the car deck, and the inspector's hands are unmarked. The culprit has skinned knuckles.
The inspector's lip is split by a blow from a bare fist. The culprit has skinned knuckles.

habits.label: Dog hair
habits.habit: Clothes covered in ginger dog hair
clues: The inspector's dark coat is covered in ginger dog hair, and dogs aren't allowed in the car deck. The culprit's clothes are covered in dog hair.
A tuft of long ginger hair, like a setter's, lies on the bunk in the inspector's cabin. The culprit's clothes are covered in ginger dog hair.

habits.label: Ribbed boots
clues: There's a crisp print of a ribbed rubber sole in a puddle of oil in the car deck. The culprit wears rubber boots with ribbed soles.
Wet herringbone prints from a rubber sole run down the steps to the engine room. The culprit wears ribbed boots.

habits.label: Speaks Swedish
clues: There's a note in Swedish in the inspector's pocket: "Car deck at half past two." The culprit knows Swedish.
The back of a waybill in the inspector's cabin has notes in Swedish, and the handwriting isn't his. The culprit reads and speaks Swedish.

habits.label: Binoculars on a strap
clues: An empty leather case for marine binoculars was left by the ladder to the car deck. The culprit carries binoculars on a strap.
The inspector's fist is clenched around a torn leather strap with a brass buckle, from a pair of binoculars. The culprit carries binoculars on a strap.

habits.label: Camera
habits.habit: A Zorki camera in a leather case
clues: A lens cap from a Zorki camera lies on the car deck floor, and the film with photos of the cargo is missing from the inspector's cabin. The culprit has a Zorki camera.
At 02:40 someone looking through the hatch saw two short flashes in the car deck, as if someone were photographing the vehicles. The culprit carries a camera.

habits.label: Blue paint
habits.habit: Hands smeared with blue ship's paint
clues: The handrails of the car deck ladder were painted blue yesterday, and the inspector's jacket has a blue handprint on it. The culprit has blue paint on their hands.
There are blue fingerprints on the handle of the inspector's cabin door, and the paint is still wet. The culprit's hands are smeared with blue ship's paint.

habits.label: Shaving cut
habits.habit: A fresh razor nick on the cheek
clues: There's a drop of someone else's blood on the inspector's collar, and blood-pink cotton wool in the basin by the car deck. The culprit has a fresh shaving cut on their cheek.
At 02:20 someone at the buffet asked for an alum block to stop the bleeding after shaving in rough seas. The culprit has a razor nick on their cheek.

habits.label: Plays patience
clues: An unfinished game of Klondike is laid out on the table in the inspector's cabin, and Bergström never played cards. The culprit plays patience.
Under the wheel of a car in the hold lies the queen of spades from the deck people have been playing patience with in the lounge all voyage. The culprit loves patience.

habits.label: Knits
clues: A grey wool thread is caught on the bumper of the lorry next to the body, and a knitting needle lies underneath. The culprit knits.
The bolt on the cabin door can be slid from outside with a thin needle through the gap, and there's a fresh scratch in the paint. The culprit knits.

habits.label: Smells of fish
clues: The car deck near the body reeks of smoked herring, and the crates of fish are on another deck. The culprit smells of smoked fish.
The inspector's sleeve has a greasy stain that smells of smoked herring. The culprit smells of smoked fish.

habits.label: Tea with rum
clues: A buffet glass of cold tea that smells of rum stands on the bonnet of a car in the hold. The culprit drinks tea with rum.
There are two cups in the inspector's cabin, one with rum in the tea, and Bergström doesn't drink on duty. The culprit drinks tea with rum.

habits.label: Missing button
habits.habit: A button missing from the pea coat
clues: A brass anchor button, torn off with a bit of cloth, was found under the wheel of the lorry. The culprit's pea coat is missing a button.
On the rug in the inspector's cabin there's a thread of black wool still attached to a brass button. The culprit's pea coat is missing a button.

keys: The inspector's cabin was unlocked and locked again with its own key, and there are only three keys to it. The culprit had keys.
The grille to the car deck is locked for the night, and its lock is intact. The culprit had keys.
sched: It all happened between the watchman's rounds, in a twenty-minute window. The culprit knows the schedule.
Under the ship's routine the car deck lights go off at 02:30, and that time was used precisely. The culprit knows the schedule.
strong: The inspector's body was carried down the steep ladder to the car deck. The culprit is physically strong.
The heavy hatch cover over the car deck was lifted without the winch. The culprit is physically strong.
passages: A service crawlway behind a panel leads from the cabin corridor to the car deck, and passengers aren't told about it. The culprit knows the service passages.
Nobody was seen at the main ladder to the car deck, but a fresh trail runs through the ventilation shaft. The culprit knows the service passages.
tech: The lamps in the car deck went out because a fuse was unscrewed, while the rest of the lights work. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The alarm in the car deck has been disabled with a jumper across its terminals. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
tools: The lashing of the car next to the body was loosened with an adjustable spanner and tightened again. The culprit is handy with tools.
The cabin door was taken off its hinges and put back, the screws driven in without a single scratch. The culprit is handy with tools.
cash: Three days' takings are missing from the buffet till, yet the accounts balance. The culprit had access to money.
A bundle of kronor seized from smugglers is missing from the inspector's briefcase, and the inventory has been rewritten. The culprit had access to money.
perfume: The inspector's cabin smells of heavy, sweet perfume. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
The collar of the inspector's coat smells of a thick perfume he never wore. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
medic: There's a needle mark on the inspector's neck, and the car deck smells of ether. The culprit knows about poisons.
The inspector's thermos contains a sleeping draught, exactly enough to keep him asleep until the car deck. The culprit knows about poisons.
driver: A car in the hold has been moved two metres to hide the body, and its engine is still warm. The culprit can drive.
The key in the lorry's ignition is turned, and the gearstick is in reverse. The culprit can drive.
safe: The ship's safe with the customs papers was opened without force, and one folder is missing. The culprit knows the safe combination.
Only a handful of people knew the combination of the safe in the inspector's cabin, and its door has been closed neatly. The culprit knows the safe combination.
french: The last sentence in the inspector's notebook was finished in French in someone else's hand. The culprit knows French.
At about 02:40 someone on deck heard an argument in French by the car deck hatch. The culprit knows French.
cane: There are round prints of a rubber cane tip on the oily car deck floor. The culprit walks with a cane.
At about 02:35 someone in the cabin corridor heard a cane tapping on iron. The culprit walks with a cane.
quiet: There's a watch at the ladder all night, yet nobody heard footsteps on the iron steps. The culprit moves silently.
Because of the storm the passengers in the cabins by the car deck sleep lightly, yet they heard nothing. The culprit moves silently.
whistle: Whistling could be heard from the car deck over the noise of the storm. The culprit whistles.
The engine room crew remember a tune someone was whistling by the hatch at 02:45. The culprit whistles.
